module.description:
**Which module this dashboard belongs to, and therefore who may see it.** Added 22 September for the command centre: one shell that shows each login the dashboards of the modules it is entitled to. **A dashboard with no module could not be placed in that shell at all** — the field the whole design hangs on did not exist.
**Required, and `core` is the answer for a dashboard that belongs to no optional module.** An empty field and *belongs everywhere* look identical, and only one of them is a decision — the rule `ModuleKey` already states for screens.
**Creating one is gated twice**, by `REPORT_MANAGE` and by the module: a principal cannot build a dashboard for a module the tenant has not licensed or that the principal holds no permission in. The server refuses with `409`; a client that hides the option has not enforced anything.

**The module rule, stated once here and used by `createDashboard`, `updateDashboard`, `listDashboards` and `getCommandCentre`** (ADAM CR-373, Chinmay, 31 October 2026; CHG-CR373-001). **Licensed**: the module is in the tenant's `LicencePosition.licensedModules`, read in process through `subscription#contractRecords`, `subscription#licenceAddOnRecords` and `subscription#planRecords`, exactly as `validateTenantConfig` and `getModuleEnablement` read it (ADAM CR-320), by the in-force contract rule `LicencePosition` states (ADAM CR-449); `core` is always licensed. **Permission held**: a module's permissions are the list under that `ModuleKey` in `x-ticvai-permission-modules` (contracts/shared/permissions.yaml); the caller holds the module when its session (`Session.permissionsByScope`) holds at least one of them at the dashboard's venue, or anywhere in its scope for a tenant-wide dashboard. No other query is asked. `createDashboard` and `updateDashboard` refuse `409 module-not-licensed` when the module is not licensed, else `409 module-permission-not-held`, and write nothing. `listDashboards` and `getCommandCentre` leave out every dashboard whose module fails either check, and a `module` filter naming such a module answers `200` with an empty list. `getDashboard` answers `404 not-found` for such a dashboard, exactly as if it did not exist (ADAM CR-450).

venueId.description: Narrows every tile to one venue. Omitting it shows each viewer everything their own scope permits — it can never show a viewer beyond that. The same rule as `RunReportRequest.venueId`.

aggregateCost.description: **Combined refresh load of every tile, as a share of the refresh budget** (ADAM CR-372, Chinmay, 31 October 2026; CHG-CR372-001). The load is the sum over the tiles of 60 / `refreshSeconds` (refreshes per minute); a tile with no `refreshSeconds` adds 0. The share is the load divided by the budget `createDashboard` already checks: `VenueSettings.reporting.dashboardRefreshBudgetPerMinute` for the dashboard's `venueId`, the tenant default when `venueId` is absent. `low` below 0.5, `medium` from 0.5 to below 0.8, `high` from 0.8; a share above 1 is still refused `400 refresh-budget-exceeded` before the band is worked out. `createDashboard` and `updateDashboard` work it out and store it in `reporting.dashboard.aggregate_cost` on every save; a later change to the budget does not rewrite stored dashboards. **The bands 0.5 and 0.8 are proposed defaults for the client to correct**, like the budget itself (configured-limits-proposal.md).

archivedAt.description:
**Set by `deleteDashboard`, which archives rather than removes.** A dashboard's tiles carry `visualisation`, `parameters` and `refresh_seconds` that somebody configured, and `reporting.dashboard_tile` cascades — so a hard delete takes an afternoon's work with it and leaves nothing to say what was there.
Archived dashboards are excluded from `listDashboards` unless asked for with `includeArchived=true`.

FinEInvoiceTransmission.description: 6.1.1. One attempt to send one tax document to the provider, and its answer.

payloadHash.description: SHA-256 of the document as sent, so a resend can be shown to be the same document.

FinEInvoiceTransmissionStatus.description: 6.1.1. `notRequired` where the legal entity's provider is `disabled` or absent.

KpiValue.description: BI board 10.3. **Value, target, variance, direction and freshness in one read.**

bucketStart.description: The start of the bucket this value covers, when `getKpiValues` was asked for an `interval`; null otherwise.

groupKey.description: The value of the `groupBy` dimension this row is for (a status, a category code, a tier); null when no `groupBy` was asked.

stale.description: **True when the pipeline behind it has not refreshed.** A number nobody flagged as stale is a number somebody will act on.

MetricValue.description:
**A reading of a metric or KPI, or a threshold on one.** A `Money` where the metric is money-valued — `MetricSource` lists those in `x-ticvai-money-valued`, and a KPI is when its `unit` is `currency` — and a plain number otherwise. naming-and-style 5.1: money is never a float, at any layer.
Stored as `numeric(18,4)` either way: a money value stores its amount, and currency and scale resolve from the scope as they do for every `Money`.

UnifiedReconciliation.description: 4.2.19. **Four sources and the variances between them.** A view showing each balanced against itself has not reconciled anything.

from.description: A day in the region's time zone, local midnight to local midnight.

to.description: A day in the region's time zone, local midnight to local midnight.

variances.description: **Where two sources disagree, named.** A discrepancy is usually the gap between two of them rather than inside one, and *"out by 240"* without saying between what is not actionable.

between.description: The two sources that disagree, as named in `sources[].source`.
